role: CloudKit sync support: timeout error, the snapshot-backfill notification name, the MainActor SyncSerializer that chains CloudKitSyncManager operations, the CloudKitSettingsSync singleton that backs UserSettings up to/restores it from an encrypted CloudKit record (dating the settings by user edits only, through an edit fingerprint), the CloudSettingsRecord field layout and edit fingerprint, and localized sync status strings. CloudSessionPayload lives in CloudSessionPayload.swift.
types: SyncTimeoutError: enum — .timedOut/.stalled thrown by CloudKitSyncManager+Push runWithTimeout
SyncSerializer: class (@MainActor) — serializes async closures by chaining Tasks
CloudKitSettingsSync: class (@Observable @MainActor singleton) — debounced/immediate settings push, restore, one-time health scrub of stored record
CloudKitSettingsSync.PushOutcome: enum (private) — pushed / keptNewerCloudCopy / skipped(String) / failed(String)
CloudSettingsRecord: enum — field names and encode/decode of settings record payload
state: mem:CloudKitSettingsSync.debounceTask / changeObserver / pushSerializer (SyncSerializer chaining pushes) / schemaUnavailable (per-launch sticky)
ck:UserSettings fields settingsPayload, modifiedAt, legacy settingsJSON, legacy deviceName (CloudSettingsRecord constants)
ud:cloudkit.settingsZoneCreated (CloudKitSettingsSync.zoneCreatedKey: this device created the UserSettings zone)
ud:cloudkit.settingsLocalEditedAt (CloudKitSettingsSync.localEditedAtKey: when the settings the user edits on this device last changed, or the restored copy's date)
ud:cloudkit.settingsEditFingerprint (CloudKitSettingsSync.editFingerprintKey: SHA-256 hex of the user-edited settings, CloudSettingsRecord.editFingerprint)
toplevel: CloudKitSettingsSync.shared is created lazily on first access (static let); its private init takes the settings edit fingerprint as a starting point and registers the settings-change observer. CloudKitSettingsSync stored-property initializers build CKContainer(identifier: AppConfig.iCloudContainerIdentifier) and the UserSettings zone ID. SyncSerializer.previous starts as an empty completed Task. SyncSerializer carries @ObservationIgnored although the class is not @Observable (no effect).

units.does: Returns localized text for SyncTimeoutError: 'Sync operation timed out — will retry' or 'Sync stalled with no progress — will retry'.
units.entry: LocalizedError witness; read via error.localizedDescription when CloudKitSyncManager reports a sync failure

units.does: Chains `body` after the previously queued Task: creates a MainActor Task that awaits the prior task then runs body, stores it as the new tail, and awaits it, so CloudKitSyncManager operations run one at a time in call order.
calls: closure:body supplied by CloudKitSyncManager: uploadSession (CloudKitSyncManager.swift:392), scrubHealthReadingsWhileSyncOff (:466), markSessionsForReupload (:627), uploadDeletion (:638), performFullSync (:674), and CloudKitSyncManager+Deletion.swift:49

units.does: Returns the container's privateCloudDatabase.

Private singleton init: takes the settings edit fingerprint as a starting point without dating an edit (takeEditFingerprint(stampingAChange: false)), then registers a NotificationCenter observer on .flowRecoverySettingsChanged (main queue) that hops to MainActor, notes the change (noteSettingsChange: the edit time moves only when a setting the user edits changed) and calls scheduleDebouncedPush().
units.entry: Runs on first access of CloudKitSettingsSync.shared (static let); the observer closure is invoked by NotificationCenter
writes: ud:cloudkit.settingsLocalEditedAt (on a settings change that alters a user-edited setting)

units.does: takeEditFingerprint(stampingAChange: true): the settings edit time moves to now only when the fingerprint of the settings the user edits changed.
units.entry: Called from the .flowRecoverySettingsChanged observer registered in init

units.does: Reads the in-memory settings JSON (nothing while the settings file is not loaded) and its edit fingerprint (CloudSettingsRecord.editFingerprint; a failure is logged and nothing changes). When it differs from the stored fingerprint, stores it and, with stampingAChange and a fingerprint already stored before, sets the settings edit time to now; a device's first fingerprint dates nothing.

branches.cond: stamping and a fingerprint was stored before

units.does: Removes the settings-zone-created flag, so the next push saves the zone again.
After a restore: takes the restored settings' fingerprint without dating an edit, then sets the settings edit time to the restored copy's date when it has one.

Runs performPush now (behind any push in flight), passing whether a newer cloud copy may be replaced (the Back Up button: true; the launch push: false). Returns true only when saved; a newer cloud copy left in place sets status .idle and returns false; skipped or failed sets status .error(reason) and returns false.
units.entry: Called by EmuquApp's launch hook (pushSettingsToCloudAfterLaunch) and the Back Up Settings button (DataSettingsPage.backupSettingsNow, replacing)

units.does: Restores settings from iCloud: requires the confirmed iCloud account (requireConfirmedAccount; another account's settings are never restored), fetches record 'primary' without creating the zone, extracts the settings JSON (legacy plaintext or decrypted payload), overlays this device's Health-filled profile fields, hands it to SettingsManager.restoreFromJSON, then dates the restored settings with the copy's modifiedAt and takes their edit fingerprint (noteRestored, so the restore is not counted as an edit made now), and returns the record's modifiedAt (or now).
reads: ck:UserSettings record "primary" in zone UserSettings (private DB, container AppConfig.iCloudContainerIdentifier)

branches.cond: CKError unknownItem, zoneNotFound or userDeletedZone on fetch
branches.effect: throws RestoreError.noCloudCopy; any other fetch error propagates to caller
return it; else ?? falls back to Date() (now), so the UI reports the restore time as the backup date

units.does: Runs the sync manager's account check; returns when confirmed, else throws RestoreError.accountNotConfirmed with the check's reason or, when sync is stopped or the account is a different one, syncOffMessage.
The message of the reason the app stopped sync (CloudAccountIdentity.stopReason), else the localized 'iCloud sync is off'.
Localized text for RestoreError cases; accountNotConfirmed returns its own message.
units.entry: LocalizedError witness; shown by SettingsPages+Data restore alert via localizedDescription

units.does: Cancels any pending debounce task and starts a new MainActor task that sleeps 2 s and then calls performPush() (a newer cloud copy is not replaced); a .failed outcome (conflict, settings not loaded, encryption, deleted zone or CloudKit error) is shown as status .error(reason), a .skipped one (sync off, onboarding unfinished, account not confirmed) or a kept newer cloud copy leaves status alone. Skipped entirely while the schema is unavailable.

branches.effect: return without scheduling; else cancel old task and schedule

units.does: Runs pushNow(replacingNewerCloudCopy:) inside pushSerializer, behind any push already in flight, and returns its outcome.

One settings push: skipped (with the reason) while sync is off, onboarding unfinished or the schema paused (pushSkipReason), or while the iCloud account is not confirmed (requireConfirmedAccount); failed when the local settings are not fully loaded or cannot be sealed; otherwise sets status .syncing and saves the sealed settings (save).

Ensures the zone (created once per account) and saves the sealed settings over the cloud copy (saveSettingsRecord). A cloud copy edited after this device's settings, not replaced, is logged, status .idle, .keptNewerCloudCopy. A save logs and sets .lastPushed, .pushed. A zone found gone goes to zoneWasDeleted (sync stops; not recreated); a conflict sets .idle and fails with the localized 'another device updated' line; other errors go to handlePushFailure.

The settings zone this device created is gone: logs, sets status .idle, asks CloudAccountGuard.zoneWasDeleted (sync stops for the user's deletion or another account) and fails with its reason or syncOffMessage. The zone is not recreated.
Returns 'iCloud sync is off' when iCloudSyncEnabled is false or onboarding is not complete, the schema-paused message when schemaUnavailable, else nil.

branches.effect: continue; else return "iCloud sync is off"

units.does: Localized 'iCloud settings backup is paused until the app restarts'.

Gets the fully-loaded local settings JSON from SettingsManager, removes Health-filled profile fields and seals it with CloudPayloadCodec.sealForUpload. Returns .ready(sealed) or .unavailable(reason); a scrub or seal failure (no cloud key: CloudSyncError.encryptionUnavailable) also sets status=.error, and nothing is pushed.

branches.effect: continue; else log and return .unavailable("Your settings haven't finished loading yet")
log, status=.error(desc), return .unavailable(desc); never pushes plaintext

units.does: Fetches record 'primary' (a new one when unknownItem). Unless replacingNewer, returns false without writing when the cloud copy was edited after this device's last settings change (CloudSettingsRecord.cloudCopyIsNewer of the record's modifiedAt and localEditedAtKey). Otherwise writes the sealed payload dated with the local edit time (now when replacing, or when none is stored), saves, stores that time as the local edit time when replacing, and returns true.

branches.cond: not replacing and the cloud copy is newer

branches.effect: dated now; else the local edit time (?? now)
the date stored as the local edit time

units.does: Classifies a push error: permanent schema error → set schemaUnavailable, cancel debounce, status=.error(paused msg), return it; else status=.error(localizedDescription) and return it.

branches.effect: false → generic error status; true → pause settings sync for this launch

units.does: One-time (per install) rewrite of the stored settings record while iCloud Sync is off: fetches it, re-seals it with Health-filled profile fields removed (using local markers), keeps its modifiedAt, saves, and sets the done flag. A record sealed with a key this device does not hold yet stays pending (retried on a later call).
reads: ck:UserSettings record "primary" in zone UserSettings (private DB, container AppConfig.iCloudContainerIdentifier)
writes: ck:UserSettings record "primary" in zone UserSettings (private DB, container AppConfig.iCloudContainerIdentifier)

branches.effect: keep it; ?? falls back to now when absent
noteUnrewritableRecord: keyNotOnThisDevice stays pending, malformed marks done
log; flag not set so it retries next call

units.does: For a stored settings record this device could not read: keyNotOnThisDevice is logged and left pending so the scrub retries once iCloud Keychain delivers the key; any other RestoreError (damage) is logged and the scrub marked done, leaving the record to the device that wrote it.

Returns at once when this device already created the UserSettings zone (zoneCreatedKey, kept across launches). Otherwise, on a device that has synced sessions (the session manager's zoneCreated or lastSyncDate), first checks that the session zone is still in iCloud and throws CKError.zoneNotFound when it is gone (the app's iCloud data was deleted), creating nothing. Then saves the UserSettings zone and sets the flag. Errors propagate; a zone that is gone later is not recreated here.

branches.cond: zone already created by this device

units.does: Fetches the zone from the private database: true when it is there, false on zoneNotFound or userDeletedZone; any other error is thrown.
Pure: false when the cloud copy has no date; true when this device has no edit time; otherwise whether the cloud date is later than the local one.
Decodes UserSettings JSON, drops Health-filled profile fields (withoutHealthFilledProfile) and re-encodes (iso8601, sortedKeys).

Builds the uploadable settings JSON (uploadable: Health-filled profile values left out), parses it as a JSON object (throws CocoaError.coderReadCorrupt when it is not one), drops appWrittenFields (schema version, HRV baselines, trial start, sync switch, onboarding and launch-task flags), re-serializes with sorted keys and returns the SHA-256 digest in lowercase hex. Decode and encode errors propagate.
Decodes the stored settings, adds to its Health-filled markers each field this device marks Health-filled whose value equals the stored one, then removes Health-filled fields and re-encodes.
Decodes restored settings, puts back this device's Health-filled profile values (keepingHealthFilledProfile) and re-encodes.
Builds a JSONEncoder with iso8601 dates and sortedKeys.
Builds a JSONDecoder with iso8601 dates.
Sets settingsPayload and modifiedAt on the record and nils legacy settingsJSON and deviceName fields.
writes: ck:UserSettings fields (in-memory CKRecord, persisted by caller save)
